# AI compiler research

PROFILE

I’m **Tianxing Ren**, a doctoral student in engineering at Peking University, in a joint program with Zhongguancun Laboratory.

I research AI compilers to help diverse AI algorithms run correctly and efficiently on emerging AI hardware, and to make programming easier for people and agents.

[Explore projects](https://tianxingren-work.github.io/projects/) [Contact me](https://tianxingren-work.github.io/contact/)

AI COMPILERS TILE-LEVEL PROGRAMMING HETEROGENEOUS COMPUTING

RESEARCH

## Research Projects

I develop AI compiler backends that bring tile-level programming to emerging hardware.

01 / Project lead
Milestone completed [Open source](https://github.com/TongmingLAIC/tilelang-tpu)

### [TileLang-TPU](https://tianxingren-work.github.io/projects/tilelang-tpu/)

A TileLang backend for SOPHGO TPUs, from compile-time memory planning to executable kernels.

### [TileLang-RISC-V](https://tianxingren-work.github.io/projects/tilelang-riscv/)

Bringing TileLang to RISC-V CPUs with AME matrix acceleration. An ongoing effort with open-source hardware and systems researchers.

BACKGROUND

## Research and experience

I’m a doctoral student in engineering at Peking University, in a joint program with Zhongguancun Laboratory. My research focuses on AI compilers, tile-level programming and heterogeneous computing, with related interests in programming languages and computer architecture.

[Prof. Tao Xie](https://taoxiease.github.io/) and [Prof. Wei Yang](https://youngwei.com/) supervise my doctoral research.

[More about me](https://tianxingren-work.github.io/about/)
